workarounds.symptom: [Train] prepare_data_loader drops a custom batch_sampler with more than one worker

Target files: python/ray/train/v2/torch/train_loop_utils.py, python/ray/train/v2/tests/test_torch_trainer.py. `prepare_data_loader` rebuilds the DataLoader with a `DistributedSampler` when there is more than one worker.
